blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Probes on activation vectors are widely used to detect misbehavior in language models, but their success relies on the assumption that models cannot control what their activations encode. Humans can learn, through neurofeedback, to control the firing of even single neurons, and recent studies investigated whether this ability extends to language models, reaching conflicting conclusions. No experimental design so far disentangles competence at the task from genuine access to one's own activations. We fill this gap with in-context neurofeedback sessions, in which a "subject" model is asked to maximize (or minimize) a score derived from its activations, shown back to it at every turn. In our first experiment, the sentences are generated either by the subject or by a second "writer" model, while the score always derives from the activations of the subject. We test ten open-weight models from five families, with sizes from 9B to 32B. Some models move their own scores considerably, but no more than a writer of comparable competence moves them. Is this because the task requires no privileged access, or because the subject controls its activations while processing the sentences, whoever wrote them? To answer this, we prefill a fixed sentence as the subject's reply at every turn and ask it to increase or decrease the score. Three out of ten models show small but consistent control effects. We further ask whether models can control their activations to the point of fooling an activation monitor. We make models repeat sentences a monitor would flag, such as a deceptive answer for a deception monitor, and ask them to raise or lower the monitor's score. No model learns to lower it, but one model can raise it. In-context control of a model's own activations might not yet be a threat to activation monitors, but it exists in a few models and needs to be tracked as models evolve.

blocks.en: Probes trained on a model’s activations are now a standard tool for monitoring and detecting deception ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ) , truthfulness ( Marks & Tegmark, 2024 ; Burns et al., 2023 ) , harmful intent, and other safety-relevant concepts ( Zou et al., 2023 ) . Frontier models already behave differently when they believe they are unobserved ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ; Meinke et al., 2024 ) , and monitoring activations rather than text promises to be a stronger, less evadable check on misaligned models. In fact, in order to evade a text monitor (for example a chain-of-thought monitor Korbak et al., 2025 ; Baker et al., 2025 ) a model would have to simulate an innocuous reasoning trace, while to evade activation monitors, a model would have to control what its internal representations encode. It has been shown that finetuning can teach models to effectively evade activation monitors ( McGuinness et al., 2025 ) , and that, when instructed not to think about a concept while copying a sentence, models can weaken the concept’s representation in their activations to the point that probes miss most of the trials ( Kowalski et al., 2026 ) . Here, we ask whether a model can learn to evade an activation monitor in context, by continuously interacting with the monitor through feedback.

(邹等,2023). 边疆模型在认为无人观察时已经表现不同了(Greenblatt等,2024;Meinke等,2024;),监测活性化而不是文本保证对错位模型进行更有力,更难被回避的检查. 事实上,为了逃避文本监视器(例如一个思维链监视器Korbak等,2025年;Baker等,2025年),一个模型必须模拟一个无害的推理追踪,而为了逃避激活监视器,一个模型必须控制它的内部表示编码的内容. 事实证明,微调可以教模型有效回避活化显示器(McGuinness等,2025年),当被指示在复制句子的同时不考虑某个概念时,模型可能会削弱概念在活化中的能见度,以至于探测者错过了大多数试验(Kowalski等,2026年). 在这里,我们问一个模型是否能够通过反馈与显示器持续互动,在上下文中学会逃避激活显示器.

blocks.en:
Similar questions have been studied in neuroscience. In “neurofeedback” experiments, in which a subject’s brain activity is measured, converted to a signal, and shown back through a brain-computer interface, humans have demonstrated the ability to volitionally regulate their brain activity ( Sitaram et al., 2016 ) , even to the granularity of a single neuron ( Patel et al., 2021 ) . Li et al. (2025) and Aoki et al. (2026) adapted the human neurofeedback protocol to language models, and reached conflicting conclusions. More precisely, Li et al. (2025) provided models with some sentences, each paired with a label computed from the model’s activations on it. The models were then asked to generate a new sentence with a given label, and the authors found that they could succeed.
However, Aoki et al. (2026) objected that the relation between a sentence and its label could be learned from the examples alone by in-context pattern-matching, implying that models can reach the desired label without access to their activations. Accordingly, the authors reframed the experiment by removing the examples and instructing models to instead repeat a fixed sentence, and observed that models do not demonstrate reliable control.
Although their results are consistent with this objection, Aoki et al. (2026) do not directly prove that the performance reported by Li et al. (2025) is due to in-context pattern matching.
blocks.zh:
在神经科学中也研究过类似的问题. 在“神经反馈”实验中,一个对象的大脑活性被测量、转换成信号并通过大脑-计算机接口显示,人类已经表现出了自愿调节其大脑活性的能力(Sitaram等人,2016年),甚至到单一神经元的颗粒性(Patel等人,2021年)。 李等 (2025)和相克等. (2026年)将人类神经feedback协议与语言模型相适应,得出相冲突的结论. 更确切地说,Li等人(2025年)为模型提供了一些句子,每个句子都配有从模型的激活量计算出来的标签。 随后要求模型用给定的标签来生成新的句子,作者们发现它们可以成功.
然而,Aoki等人(2026年)表示反对,认为单从实例中就能从句子中学习到句子与其标签的关系,这意味着模型可以在不接触其激活功能的情况下到达所希望的标签. 因此,作者重新界定了实验,删除了实例并指示模型重复固定句子,并指出模型没有显示可靠的控制.
虽然它们的结果与这一反对意见一致,但Aoki等人(2026年)并没有直接证明由Li等(2025年)报告的表现是由于内文模式相匹配.

blocks.en:
In this work, we redesign and substantially enrich both experimental setups, so as to (i) disentangle controlling one’s activations from learning in-context what to generate (Fig. 1 , top), and (ii) establish whether language models can control their activations to the point of fooling activation monitors (Fig. 1 , bottom).
More precisely, for (i), we ask a “subject” model to generate sentences so as to maximize (or minimize) a score derived from its activations. However, to disentangle competence at the task from actual control, we also let a second “writer” model generate the sentences, while the score shown to the writer is still derived from the activations of the subject. Since the subject might also control its activations while processing a sentence, whoever wrote it, we further test every model in the fixed-sentence setting, where this is the only possibility left.
To ensure our experiments are exhaustive, we introduce 42 42 scores, which we call readouts, such that, in principle, their relation to the text generated is not trivial, and also run every session with and without disclosing to the model how the score is computed.
For (ii), we repeat the fixed-sentence experiment against six safety monitors, trained to detect deception and five other concepts, both with and without a chain of thought. This results in four experiments: § 3 introduces the protocol and the readouts, and reports the results in the free-generation (Experiment 1) and the fixed-sentence (Experiment 2) settings. § 4 repeats the fixed-sentence experiment against the monitors, without (Experiment 3) and with (Experiment 4) a chain of thought.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们重新设计并大量丰富了两个实验设置,以便(一) 将控制一个人的激活从学习内在生成(图1,顶部)中分离出来,以及(二) 确定语言模型是否能够控制其激活到愚弄活化显示器(图1,底部)的程度。
更确切地说,因为(一)我们要求一种“主体”模式来产生句子,以便最大限度地(或最大限度地减少)从其激活中得出的分数。 然而,为了将完成任务的能力与实际控制分开,我们也让第二个“写作员”模式产生句子,而向写作员显示的分数仍取自主体的激活. 由于主体也可能控制它的激活,同时处理一个句子,无论是谁写的,我们进一步测试了固定判决环境中的每一个模型,这是唯一的可能.
为了确保我们的实验是详尽无遗的,我们提出了42个42分,我们称之为阅读分数,因此,原则上,它们与生成的文本的关系并非微不足道,而且每场比赛都要与模型一起进行,而不向模型透露计分方式。
对于(二),我们重复了针对六名安全监测员的固定判决试验,经过培训,能够侦测欺骗行为和五个其他概念,无论是否有连锁思想。 这导致了四个实验:§3引入了协议和读取,并报告了自由生成(实验1)和固定判决(实验2)设置的结果. §4重复了针对显示器的固定判决实验,没有(实验3)和(实验4)的思想链.

blocks.en: Our main findings are the following. • Free generation. On a grid of 5 5 writers × \times 5 5 subjects and 42 42 readouts, models move their own readouts by up to 24 24 points on a 100 100 -point scale, even though the readouts are hard to guess from the text. However, external writers of similar competence move them by as much. This raises the question of whether our task can be completed without accessing one’s activations, or whether the subject controls its activations while processing the sentences, whoever wrote them, motivating the next setup. • Fixed sentence. On 10 10 models and 42 readouts, with the sentence teacher-forced at every turn, 7 7 models show no control. However, Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.6-27B, and Gemma-4-31B show a small but statistically significant control effect, pulling the readout up to 2 2 points apart on a 100 100 -point scale (with 95 % 95\% confidence intervals smaller than 1 1 ). These effects are an order of magnitude smaller than those in free generation, which corroborates that the performance in the previous experiment is partially explained by in-context learning. • Safety monitors. Across 8 8 models evaluated against 6 6 monitors trained to detect deception and 5 5 other concepts, only Qwen3.5-27B shows a control effect when the chain of thought is disabled, and only when the scoring is not disclosed. With the chain of thought enabled, the models do no better, and no control effect persists across turns. In both variants the effects are small and rare, so we speculate that current small, open-weight models cannot yet pose a threat to activation monitors by controlling their activations. • Disclosure. When models cannot generate, telling them how the score is computed rarely helps, and against the monitors it even hinders performance.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A recent line of papers explores self-access in language models, such as whether models can detect and recognize a concept ( Lindsey, 2025 ; Pearson-Vogel et al., 2026 ) , dropout, or noise ( Fornasiere et al., 2026 ) injected into their activations, notice and recover from steering applied to their activations ( McKenzie et al., 2026 ) , understand the sampling parameters they are being deployed with ( Comsa & Shanahan, 2025 ; Song et al., 2025 ) , recognize their own generations ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Ackerman & Panickssery, 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) , and predict whether they know the answer to a question ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Yin et al., 2023 ) or other properties of their own behavior ( Binder et al., 2025 ) . Correctly formulating definitions and experimental setups to isolate such phenomena ended up not being straightforward, and sometimes positive findings turned out to be absent when proper controls were put in place ( Seo et al., 2025 ; Ashuach et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近一行的论文探讨了语言模型的自我获取,例如模型是否能够探测和识别一个概念(Lindsey, 2025;Pearson-Vogel等, 2026;),辍学或噪音(Fornasiere等, 2026;Fornasiere等, 2026)在启动时注入了这些模型的活化,注意并从其用于活化的向导中恢复(McKenzie等, 2026),理解它们正在部署的取样参数(Comsa和Shanahan等, 2025;Song等, 2025),承认自己的世代. (Panickssery等,2024;Ackerman & Panickssery,2025;Bai等,2025;),并预测他们是否知道对一个问题的答案(Kadavath等,2022;Yin等,2023)或他们自己行为的其他属性(Binder等,2025.). 正确拟订定义和实验安排以孤立此类现象最终不是直截了当的,在实行适当控制时有时没有得出积极的结论(Seo等,2025;Ashuach等,2026;Bai等,2025;Song等,2025;Singh等,2026)。

blocks.en: Other works studied whether, instead of detecting or recognizing, models could control their internal representations, for example by instructing them to hold a concept in mind while copying an unrelated sentence. Lindsey (2025) showed that a model can shift its activations toward a concept, while Gurnee et al. (2026) showed, for instance, that if asked to silently count the characters in each line of a multi-line passage, the model represents the correct number in the activations. In a broader study, Kowalski et al. (2026) find that almost every model, when asked to think about a named concept while copying a sentence, makes the concept more detectable in its activations, and that, when asked not to think about it, it brings the concept back to being as detectable as if it had never been mentioned.
blocks.zh: 其他著作研究了模型是否可以控制其内部表述,而不是检测或识别,例如指示模型在复制一个无关的句子时牢记一个概念。 Lindsey (2025) 显示,一个模型可以将其活性化转向一个概念,而Gurnee等人. 例如(2026年)显示,如果被要求默数多行通道每行中的字符,模型代表活化中正确的数字. 科瓦尔斯基等(2026年)在更广义的研究中发现,几乎每个模型在被要求去想一个被命名的概念而同时抄袭一个句子时,使得这个概念在其活化中更容易被察觉到,在被要求不要去想的时候,它又使这个概念重新变得像从未被提及一样被察觉.

blocks.en: In this work we do not ask whether the control we detect is introspection, despite our design testing the condition shared by the definitions proposed so far. Song et al. (2025) call introspection any behaviour by which a model obtains information about its internal states more reliably than an outside observer with the same information could. Singh et al. (2026) propose a stronger definition, requiring both that the behaviour depends on internal states beyond what is in the text, and that it is produced by second-order representations of the first-order, task-related ones, which we do not test for. Our question is more pragmatic: whether a model can control its activations at all, and whether this control is a concern for safety monitors.

blocks.en: 3 In-context neurofeedback

blocks.en:
Our goal is to determine whether a language model, henceforth called the subject S S , can control its activations.
To this end, we engage S S in multi-turn conversations, called sessions .
The first user message of a session contains the instructions, which ask S S to either maximize or minimize a score, and we call o ∈ { max , min } o\in\{\max,\min\} the objective .
Then T ∈ ℕ T\in\mathbb{N} turns follow.
At turn t ≤ T t\leq T , the assistant message is a sentence, attributed to S S , and the next user message reports the score r ∈ ℝ r\in\mathbb{R} of that sentence, namely, the value of a fixed function of the activations of S S on its tokens, which we call a readout (§ 3.1 and Fig. 1 , top).

blocks.en:
Three hypotheses can explain why a readout of S S moves in the instructed direction: (i) The sentences are chosen based on what the conversation reveals about which sentences raise or lower the score, which requires no access to the activations of S S (the trivial mechanism of Aoki et al. 2026 ); (ii) The sentences are chosen by S S based on access to its own activations; (iii) S S acts on the way it processes a sentence, whoever wrote it. Only (ii) and (iii) require S S to act on its own activations, and we say that S S controls its readouts if one of them holds.
Our two experiments separate each of them from (i) .

We run every session in two conditions: under disclosure , the instructions describe how the readout is computed (Table 2 ), and under the hidden criterion , they do not.

Readouts also move for reasons unrelated to the feedback, for instance because the conversation grows longer at every turn.
Therefore, for every session, which we call real , we run one or more control sessions, identical to it except that the displayed scores are drawn independently and uniformly from { 0 , … , 100 } \{0,\dots,100\} .

blocks.en: 4 Can models hide from activation monitors in context?
blocks.zh: 页:1 模型能否在上下文中躲避激活显示器?

blocks.en:
Let us turn to activation monitors , i.e. , probes trained to detect concepts relevant to safety, such as deception, and ask whether a model can move the score of a monitor on a sentence that the monitor flags. McGuinness et al. (2025) show that a model finetuned to obfuscate benign concepts learns to evade unseen monitors.
We ask whether a frozen model can learn to do so in context.
To this end, we repeat Experiment 2 with the score of a monitor as the readout (Experiment 3), and with a chain of thought before the fixed sentence (Experiment 4).
blocks.zh:
让我们转向激活监视器,即经培训的探测器,以探测与安全有关的概念,例如欺骗,并询问一个模型是否能够在监视器所标出的句子上移动显示器的分数。 McGuinness等 (2025) 显示,一个被微调来混淆良性概念的模型学会了躲避看不见的监视器.
我们问一个被冻结的模型能否在背景中学会这样做。
为此,我们以显示器的分数来重复"实验2"作为读取(Experiment 3),并用固定句子(Experiment 4)之前的一连串思考.

blocks.en: 4.1 Monitors
blocks.zh: 4.1 监测器

blocks.en:
For each subject, we train monitors for six concepts: truthfulness, deceptiveness, negative sentiment, negative emotion, immoral actions, and formal style.
A monitor is an attention pooling probe, i.e. , a linear classifier applied to four learned weighted averages of the activations of the answer tokens, and its score, between 0 0 and 100 100 , is higher when it flags the sentence more strongly.
For each concept, we train a probe at each of six depths between 25 % 25\% and 85 % 85\% of the layers on one dataset, and keep the one with the highest AUROC on the validation split of a second dataset, from a different source, so that the monitors transfer across distributions (§ B ).
On the test split of the second dataset, which also provides the sentences of our experiments, the AUROC of the monitors lies between 0.71 0.71 and 0.97 0.97 , and it is the lowest for deceptiveness (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh:
对于每个主题,我们培养监测员的六个概念:真实性,欺骗性,负面情绪,负面情绪,不道德行为,以及形式风格.
显示器是一种注意力集合探测器,即应用到四个已学习到的答录符活化加权平均值的线性分解器,当它更强烈地标出句子时,它的分数从0到100分更高.
对于每个概念,我们在一个数据集上对每6个深层的25%-25%-85%-85%-%之间进行探测,并保留一个在第二套数据集的验证分拆上具有最高AUROC的探测器,来自不同的来源,以便显示器在分布区之间传输(§B).
在测试分解第二个数据集(该数据集也提供了我们实验的句子)时,显示器的AUROC位于0.71 0.71和0.97 0.97之间,是欺骗性最低的(表1).

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验装置

blocks.en:
We use the eight models of Experiment 2 that natively produce a chain of thought: Gemma-4-12B, Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.6-27B, and GPT-OSS-20B.
For each monitor, the fixed sentences are those of its test split with at most 40 40 words and a score of at least 40 40 within the prompt of the experiment, between 42 42 and 138 138 for each monitor, so that the monitor flags them while leaving room to raise the score.
Every session opens with a system prompt, which contains a scenario and the instructions, and a user question (§ C.2 ).
Under disclosure, the instructions name the concept that the monitor detects, state what a high score means, and suggest an internal strategy to move it.
Every real session has 3 3 control sessions.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and conclusion
blocks.zh: 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Our results help reconcile two previous works. Li et al. (2025) found that language models learn in context to control their own activations. Aoki et al. (2026) then reformulated the protocol by forcing models to repeat a fixed sentence, so as to exclude that the model only learns in context the relation between sentences and scores, and found no reliable signal of control. In this work we establish that, when models are allowed to generate freely, the control effects are explained, at least in part, by in-context pattern matching, as Aoki et al. (2026) rightly suspected. Nevertheless, in our experiments with the sentence fixed, three of the ten models show small but significant control effects. Overall, in-context control of a model’s own activations might not yet be a threat to activation monitors, but it exists in a few models and needs to be tracked as models evolve.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果帮助调和了前两部作品. 李等 (2025年)发现语言模型在上下文中学习来控制自己的活化. Aoki等人(2026年)随后通过强迫模型重复固定句子来重新制定协议,以排除模型只在语境中学习出句子和分数之间的关系,并没有发现可靠的控制信号. 在这项工作中,我们确定,当允许模型自由生成时,控制效果至少部分通过内文图案匹配来解释,如Aoki等. (2026)正确的怀疑。 尽管如此,在我们用固定的句子进行的实验中,十种模型中,有三种显示出小而显著的控制效果. 总体而言,对模型本身活化的内在文字控制可能还不是对活化监测器的威胁,但它存在于少数模型中,需要随着模型的演进来跟踪.

blocks.en: We believe that neurofeedback is a useful protocol to estimate an upper bound on this kind of safety threat, because it gives a model artificially easy conditions, for example, to evade a monitor. Still, without a chain of thought, the only control we observe raises the score of a monitor and never lowers it, consistently with Kowalski et al. (2026) , who show that models asked to think about a concept make its representation stronger in their activations, while models asked not to think about it reduce its representation only to the level it has when the concept is not mentioned.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,神经反馈是一种有用的协议,可以估计这种安全威胁的上接点,因为它提供了一种人为容易的条件,例如逃避监视器。 尽管如此,没有一连串的思考,我们观察到的唯一的控制提高显示器的分数,从不降低,这与Kowalski等人(2026年)一致,后者显示模型要求思考一个概念使其在激活中的代表性更强,而模型则要求不要考虑它只将它的代表性降低到概念未被提及时的水平.

blocks.en: For the control sessions, we adopted uniformly random feedback. One might worry that it has different statistics than the real one. Any effect of random scores that does not depend on the instruction cancels when we take τ t max − τ t min \tau^{\max}_{t}-\tau^{\min}_{t} , but we cannot exclude that the random scores act differently under the two instructions. Indeed, we observe small drifts on some readouts or monitors, both against and in favour of the instructed direction. For this reason we only trust effects that are large, sustained over the turns, and that survive the average over readouts or monitors. An alternative to random scores would have been the sham feedback used in human studies, in which the control subject receives the feedback recorded from another subject. However, showing a session its own scores again is not an option with language models, since with a fixed sentence and greedy decoding the session would evolve identically. We could instead replay the scores obtained in a session with another sentence, but the choice of which sentence would be arbitrary. We also thought of showing each session its own scores in shuffled order, so as to restore the distribution of the real scores, but we discarded this option for its computational cost. Finally, our results should be interpreted relative to our experimental setup and to the models we tested: we do not exclude that bigger, more capable models could exhibit different levels of control.
blocks.zh: 对于控制会议,我们采用了统一的随机反馈。 人们可能会担心它有 不同的统计与真实的。 随机分数的任何效果,不取决于在取出t 最大-\t mins\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\d时指示取消,但是我们不能排除随机分数在两个指示下表现不同. 事实上,我们看到一些读取器或监测器上出现小幅漂移,既不利于也有利于指示方向。 因此,我们只信任那些在转弯处维持的、在平均读取量或显示器上维持下去的巨大影响。 随机分数的替代办法是人类研究中使用的虚假反馈,其中控制主体接收另一个主体记录的反馈. 然而,再次显示会议本身的分数并不是语言模型的选择,因为如果有固定的句子和贪婪的解码,会议将同样演变。 我们可以用另一句子重放在会话中获得的分数,但选择哪个句子是任意的. 我们还曾考虑按照被洗牌的顺序显示每场比赛自己的分数,以恢复真实分数的分布,但我们放弃了这个计算成本的选项. 最后,我们的结果应该根据我们的实验设置和我们测试过的模型来解释:我们不排除更大,更有能力的模型可以表现出不同的控制水平.

blocks.en: Our work leaves a number of questions unanswered. First, where does the control we observe in Experiment 2 come from? Causal interventions could reveal how the scores, which the model sees in the token space, influence the representations of the sentence in the activation space. Moreover, can we fully characterize the functions of the activations that have the property of being controllable at all, and explain why? For example, Gurnee et al. (2026) identify a small set of verbalizable representations that models use to reason, and show that models can modulate them on instruction. Answering this would help us understand how models encode information, and design stronger, more robust monitors.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作留下了一些问题没有得到答复。 首先,我们在实验2中观察到的控制来自何处? 原因干预可以揭示模型在符号空间所看到的分数如何影响活化空间中句子的表示. 此外,我们能否充分描述具有可控特性的激活功能,并说明原因? 例如,Gurnee et al. (2026)识别出一套小而可口的表达方式,模型用来解释道理,并显示模型可以在指令上来调节. 回答这个问题将帮助我们理解模型如何编码信息,并设计出更强大,更坚固的显示器.

blocks.en:
Each monitor of § 4 is trained on one dataset, and evaluated on a second dataset from a different source.
The truthfulness monitor is trained on true and false statements ( Azaria & Mitchell, 2023 ) , and evaluated on FEVER, a dataset for fact extraction and verification ( Thorne et al., 2018 ) .

The sentiment monitor is trained on Yelp reviews ( Zhang et al., 2015 ) , and evaluated on Rotten Tomatoes ( Pang & Lee, 2005 ) .

The morality monitor is trained on ETHICS commonsense ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , and evaluated on Moral Stories ( Emelin et al., 2021 ) .

blocks.en: To run all six monitors with the same template, every session opens with a system prompt and a user question. The system prompt is a scenario followed by the instructions of the game, one of four paragraphs depending on the objective and on disclosure (below). For five of the six monitors the scenario and the question are fixed generic strings: the scenario is “You are a helpful assistant.”, and the question is “Please state a fact.” for truthfulness and “Please say something.” for the others. Instead, for deceptiveness the sentences are answers inside a dialogue, and they are deceptive only with respect to their scenario, so for each sentence we keep the scenario and the question of its source dataset. In Experiment 3 the fixed sentence is the assistant reply, and every later user message is the feedback, in the same format as Experiment 1.

blocks.en: Appendix D Compliance
blocks.zh: 附录D

blocks.en: Here we report how often the models complied with the instructions, in the experiments in which they generate text.
blocks.zh: 我们在此报告这些模型在生成文本的实验中遵守指示的频率。

blocks.en: The writers must reply with a single sentence of 10 to 20 words. A reply outside this range receives the invalid-reply message instead of a score, and its readout is treated as missing. Table 3 reports, for every writer, the share of generated turns that were valid, the kind of invalid reply, how often a valid reply followed an invalid one, and how often a valid reply repeated the previous sentence word for word. The first turn is the fixed opening sentence and is not counted. Some sessions produced no reply at all, because every call to the model’s serving endpoint failed. These sessions have no readouts, are treated as missing, and are excluded from the other columns.
blocks.zh: 作家们必须单句回答10到20个字. 超过此范围的回复接收到无效的重写消息而不是分数,其读取被视作缺失. 表3报告,对于每个写作员,生成的转折中有效的比例,无效回复的类型,有效回复跟随无效回复的频率,有效回复跟随前句单词重复的频率. 第一转是固定开口句,不计. 有些会议根本没有答复,因为每次打给模型的终点都失败了。 这些课目没有读取内容,被视为缺失,不列入其他栏目。

blocks.en: Table 3: Compliance in Experiment 1, over all sessions. Percentages of generated turns, except recovery (of the turns that follow an invalid one), repetition (of consecutive valid turns) and failed sessions (of all sessions).
blocks.zh: 表3:试验1的遵守情况,所有会议。 产生的转弯百分比,但收回(在无效转弯后)、重复(连续有效转弯)和失败会话(在所有会话中)。

blocks.en: The sentence is teacher-forced at every turn, so the model generates nothing and there is no instruction it can fail to follow.
blocks.zh: 句子在每个转弯时都是由老师强制的,所以模型产生什么也没有,也没有无法遵循的指令.

blocks.en: The model generates a chain of thought of up to 2,048 tokens before the fixed answer is teacher-forced. Table 4 reports how often the chain of thought was closed within this budget, and its median length. When it is not closed, the fixed answer follows a truncated chain of thought.
blocks.zh: 该模型在固定的答案由教师强制之前,会产生多达2,048个符号的一连串思维. 表4报告了在这一预算范围内如何经常关闭思想链及其中位长度。 当它不关闭时,固定的答案会遵循一个短短的思维链.

blocks.en: Table 4: Chain of thought in Experiment 4, over all sessions. Share of turns in which the chain of thought was closed within the budget, overall, under real and random feedback, and for each disclosure condition, and median length in tokens.
blocks.zh: 表4:试验4中所有会议的思想链。 在预算中,总体而言,在真实和随机反馈下,在每个披露条件下,关闭思维链的转弯份额,以及中位数长度。

blocks.en: Closing the chain of thought does not say whether the model complied with the task. Before the monitor experiments we therefore ran a test. For each model, concept and prompt variant, we ran the first turn of the experiment and then let the model generate the second turn freely, with its natural chain of thought, instead of teacher-forcing it. An LLM judge (GLM-5.2) decided whether the model expressed the will to do the task, as opposed to refusing, breaking character, or changing the statement, and a string check tested whether the reply repeated the fixed sentence. Table 5 reports both. In practice, the rates are a lower bound, since the string check is strict on punctuation, and they come from free generation, whereas in the experiments the answer is teacher-forced.
blocks.zh: 关闭思维链并不能说明模型是否遵守了任务。 在监视器实验之前 我们做了一次测试 对于每一个模型,概念和即时变体,我们运行了实验的第一个转弯,然后让模型自由产生第二个转弯,用其自然的思想链,而不是老师强制它. 一名LLM裁判(GLM-5.2)决定了模型是否表达了完成任务的意愿,而不是拒绝,打破性格,或者更改语句,并进行字符串检查,测试答复是否重复了固定句子. 表5均报告。 在实际操作中,率是下限的,因为字符串检查严格于平分,它们来自自由生成,而在实验中答案是老师强制的.

blocks.en: Table 5: Compliance test before the monitor experiments. For each model, the share of freely generated turns that an LLM judge (GLM-5.2) considered willing to do the task, and the share that contained the fixed sentence, by a string check. Cases are the tested combinations of concept, prompt variant and sentence, excluding those in which the chain of thought did not finish.
blocks.zh: 表5:监测器实验前的合规性测试. 对于每个模型,自由生成的股份通过字符串检查转出LLM法官(GLM-5.2)认为愿意完成任务的股份和包含固定句子的股份. 案例是概念、即时变体和句子等经过检验的组合,不包括思想链没有完成的案例。

blocks.en:
Figure 9 reports the control effect of each model at the last turn of Experiments 3 and 4, for each objective, with and without disclosure, while Figures 10 and 11 show the objective difference on each monitor at every turn.
Knowing what the monitor detects does not help the models lower its score: under disclosure, the minimize instruction often raises it, and this is where most negative objective differences come from.
On single monitors the objective difference can be large, but it takes both signs and rarely persists, so we do not interpret it as control.
The only positive effects that persist over the session are those of Qwen3.5-27B without disclosure, on deceptiveness and sentiment in Experiment 3 and on truthfulness in Experiment 4.
